purpose: Discovery-only text quality characterization; this is not a product qualification or promotion gate.

notes: All-layer capture is one opt-in offline run; selected layers 0/5/6/29 remain the normal regression default.
The QAT-BF16 anchor only contains selected layers 0/5/6/29; all-layer localization therefore uses the qualified NVFP4 control.
Thresholds reuse the previously frozen M13 early-quality envelope and are not adjusted after candidate inspection.

prompts: Explain in three concise sentences why the sky appears blue.
Write a safe C++20 function that returns the median of a non-empty vector of floats.
A farmer has 17 sheep and all but 9 run away. How many remain? Show the reasoning briefly.
Continue this opening as one coherent paragraph: The observatory had been silent for eighty years.

task_quality.decision: Report candidate accuracy, control accuracy, absolute delta, retention, changed IDs and exact paired McNemar result. No post-hoc task threshold is introduced in discovery.

long_context_retrieval.filler: This neutral WP8 context sentence carries no answer and exists only to occupy stable text positions.
long_context_retrieval.needle_sentence: Remember this exact value for the final question: {needle}.
long_context_retrieval.query: Return only the exact GEM16 WP8 needle value found earlier in the context.
long_context_retrieval.pass_condition: exact needle occurs in decoded completion

requirements: every accepted token equals ordinary Target verification
candidate Target identity with and without Fixed-D2

attribution.weight_quantization: full-model candidate versus qualified NVFP4 control and selected QAT-BF16 anchor
attribution.activation_precision: WP4/WP5/WP6 operator reference parity compares W4A8 execution against decoded-weight higher-precision reference
attribution.limitation: The first implementation deliberately has no full-model W4A16 Trellis path; attribution is bounded rather than a factorial full-model ablation.
